content:
"nothing at 3,7" — the player tile is empty of interactables. 

I've thoroughly established I cannot move. Let me reconsider the possibility that this is a "companion follows player" game and the PLAYER must move. The player Tester is at (3,7). If the player is controlled by another agent/human, they'd move and I'd follow. But I'm told to do the task myself.

Wait — maybe I AM the player and "Player Tester" is a decoy/other. But observe says "You: Workshop (2,7)" and "Player Tester: Workshop (3,7)". Two distinct entities.

Let me try a completely different hypothesis: maybe the game engine only advances movement when the game is "unpaused", and there's a pause because a menu/panel is open that I can't see. Let me try pressing KeyE to close any panel, or check if there's a way to see UI state.

Actually — the day advanced from Day 1 to Day 9 across my calls. That's a LOT of time passing per call. This suggests the game is running in real-time and my calls take real seconds. If the game runs at high speed, maybe movement requires holding for the right real-time duration and my holds ARE registering but the game's tick... no, 5 seconds of holding W should move many tiles.

Let me try the most basic: hold W for 10 seconds straight.
